_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The panel and its commands use the selected language, Spanish. The VM has five integrations: gh, llm, notify, reflection and a personal Slack hook "slack-hook". A Slack test answers 422 "This is a Slack bot. This test only supports incoming webhooks." Name elements by ARIA role and accessible name, as Playwright's getByRole does; "named X" means an exact name match. "The modal" is ".integrations-modal". To "open the panel": press Control+k; ".command-palette-input" should be visible; fill it with "integration", click the first ".command-palette-item", and the modal should be visible. To "select" an integration N: click the first ".integrations-tabs button" (the list), then the ".integrations-name-btn" whose text starts with N followed by a space; ".integrations-detail-head strong" should then have exactly the text N. "The refresh button" is the modal's button named "Refresh"; "the Slack test button" is the button named "Test integration (webhook only)"; "the notify button" is the button named "Send test notification". To "close the modal": click the modal's button whose name contains "Close modal". To "start": navigate to /new, wait for the element with data-testid "message-input" to be visible, and open the panel. Perform the steps in order. 1. Start. 2. ".integrations-modal .modal-title" must not have exactly the text "VM integrations", and should contain the text "integraciones" in any case (an eval lowercasing its text). 3. Select notify. ".integrations-notify button" must not have exactly the text "Send test notification". 4. Select slack-hook. Click the button named "Probar integración (solo webhook)". The element with role "alert" inside ".slack-integration" should have exactly the text "Esta integración es un bot de Slack. Esta prueba solo admite webhooks entrantes."
